{{PAGENAME}} is a female NPC who can be found on the bridge of Atuja Camp. She asks about her brother while visiting her family.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}} 
:;'''Sif''' Is Daxton alright, Pa?
:;'''Einar''' Don't you ever mention that name again. From this day on, you're our only child.
-----
:'''Einar:''' My goodness, Sif! Aren't you supposed to be at the Academy?
:'''Sif:''' I'm working on a project that requires me to collect data from Atuja... I've been wanting to see you since yesterday!
:'''Sif:''' Where's Daxton?
:'''Hailey:''' My dear child...
:'''Einar:''' Don't you ever mention that name again. From this day on, you're our only child.
:'''Sif:''' Why would you say that, Pa?! What happened to my brother?
:'''Einar:''' It was three days ago. He murdered an Ironhoof in cold blood.
:'''Hailey:''' Sif... your brother is no longer a Roya.
:'''Sif:''' No... No, that can't be! He'd never do such a thing!
:'''Einar:''' He tore off that poor creature's head and wears it as a mask. He's betrayed the Exostrider.
:'''Sif:''' Oh, Brother... How could he?
:'''Hailey:''' The mind of an Outcast is beyond our understanding...
:'''Hailey:''' It'll take some time, Sif. But, darling, do try to forget about that person.
{{Dialogue End}}
